messages:
maria (PM): quick thread — customer AlphaBank (SOC2+SOX) asked for BYOK in GovCloud + 7 year retention for audit logs. We need to decide scope (BYOK handshake, retention tiers, storage strategy) before Q3 roadmap commit.

devin (Eng): what's AlphaBank's traffic? retention 7yr huge. do they expect hot access?

maria (PM): they said "searchable evidence within 48h" for legal holds. so warm access for N months then cold. likely 48h SLA for retrieval.

sina (Security): govcloud BYOK + HSM integration will need attestation & key escrow options. also PCI/SOX controls; need KMS audit events.

oliver (Eng-Infra): two big ops concerns: storage cost + indexing cost. propose retention tiers: 90d hot, 2y warm (searchable), 7y cold (restore within 48h). also need surge policy for export during legal holds.

kevin (SRE): surge policy -> we should have capped concurrent exports per tenant + prioritized queueing. recommend burst tokens + dedicated export workers for enterprise tier.

maria (PM): sounds reasonable. devin can you estimate infra/egress cost for pilot + full roll?

devin (Eng): quick calc: pilot (1 tenant) ~ 2x current audit traffic => +0.5TB/month storage + indexing work. full (10 tenants) ~ 6TB/mo and search index ops. I'll put numbers in sheet.

sina (Security): also require KMS handshake: 1) key import flow 2) attestation doc 3) rotation & revocation process. legal wants ability to produce chain of custody.

maria (PM): acceptance criteria proposal: (1) BYOK import + validation in GovCloud, (2) retention tiers implemented, (3) evidence export runbook + automated throttling, (4) SLAs: 48h retrieval, export success >= 99% for pilot, (5) security docs + SOC2 mapping.

oliver (Eng-Infra): rollout plan: canary with AlphaBank in GovCloud us-gov-east for 3 weeks, monitor cost + retrieval SLO. If pass, scale to 3 customers, then GA. need oncall runbook.

kevin (SRE): oncall: add export fallback to Dedicated capacity when shared overloaded. playbook stub:
```
- detect export surge > threshold
- route new exports to dedicated pool
- notify oncall with alert tag: export_surge
- throttle non-critical exports
```

maria (PM): timeline ask: can we aim for pilot by end of next sprint (3 wks)? if no, what's blocker?

devin (Eng): blockers: KMS attestation API, index cost mitigation (sampling), and one infra PR for export workers. estimate 3 wks for pilot if we prioritize.

sina (Security): I can draft attestation checklist this week.

maria (PM): ok. action items: devin = cost estimate + infra PR, oliver = runbook + surge routing, sina = attestation doc, kevin = throttling alert, i'll own acceptance criteria + customer comms. will sync after numbers. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Reminder: create incident channel #pilot-alpha-evidence when pilot starts

maria (PM): noted. thanks all.
